chapters.label: Introduction
chapters.title: A Ghost Town and a Business Card
chapters.text: Start here: a short welcome from Greg, and how to use the worksheets.

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: Built to Grow, Not to Pay
chapters.text: The One Thing: Write down the number you think you can spend next year, and where it comes from.

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: Three Offices, No Table
chapters.text: The One Thing: List your advisor, CPA and attorney, and the last time any two of them spoke.

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: Head Trash
chapters.text: The One Thing: Circle the excuse you've used most, and write what it's costing you.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: P Is for Paycheck
chapters.text: The One Thing: Fill in your Paycheck Map, even roughly.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: Social Security Is a Two-Person Decision
chapters.text: The One Thing: Get both of your Social Security estimates this week.

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: A Is for Assets: The First Years Matter Most
chapters.text: The One Thing: Sort your accounts into income, growth and reserve money.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: The Care Question
chapters.text: The One Thing: Talk with your spouse about where you'd want care, and how you'd pay for it.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: T Is for Taxes: The Tax Trap
chapters.text: The One Thing: Find last year's return and circle your taxable income.

next.label: Join the free Tax Trap class

chapters.label: Chapter 9
chapters.title: Your Tax Return Is the Map
chapters.text: The One Thing: Write three "what if" questions for your return.

chapters.label: Chapter 10
chapters.title: H Is for Heirs: One Year and One Day
chapters.text: The One Thing: Pull every beneficiary form you have this week.

chapters.label: Chapter 11
chapters.title: Tenants, Toilets, and the Business
chapters.text: The One Thing: Write down what you'd do with the rentals or business if you had to decide this year.

chapters.label: Chapter 12
chapters.title: Walking the PATH
chapters.text: The One Thing: Book your PATH Review, or ask your advisor these five questions.
